description: The embedded-equivalence pair over a literal and a pattern location: run once with --source lib=lib and once with lib embedded, the reading must be byte-identical. The literal $lib/nested/top.kdl imports ../leaf.kdl relative to itself and /root.kdl from the source's root; the pattern $lib/parts/*.kdl lists the source (a directory walk, or the embedded keys) and matches parts/B.kdl before parts/a.kdl in portable-path-byte order, never parts/other.txt; every document is shown under $lib
